description:
“Assistant Han, let’s get married next Saturday.” 

Out of nowhere, a strict and seemingly cold department manager proposes marriage to his subordinate. Caught off guard by his sudden and unreasonable demand, she finds herself pulled into an unexpected contract-like relationship. As they spend more time together, what first seemed absurd begins to reveal hidden intentions—and possibly genuine feelings.
